name: Crazy Girl 36H Magic Waterproof Blush | Long-Lasting 3D Glow Makeup for Girls & Women
description:
Get a radiant, sculpted glow that lasts all day with the Crazy Girl 36H Magic Waterproof Blush. Designed for girls and women who love long-lasting color, this advanced formula delivers a 3D contour effect with a smooth matte-satin finish. Waterproof, sweatproof, and humidity-resistant, it keeps your cheeks vibrant and fresh for up to 36 hours. Lightweight and breathable, it blends seamlessly to enhance your natural beauty.Key Features:
 36-hour long-lasting blush for all-day color
 Waterproof, sweatproof & humidity-resistant formula
 3D sculpting effect enhances natural contours
 Matte-satin finish for a smooth, radiant look
 Lightweight texture, comfortable for all-day wearHow to Use:
1⃣ Lightly swirl your brush onto the blush surface.
2⃣ Apply to the apples of your cheeks.
3⃣ Blend upward toward your temples.
4⃣ Build layers for a deeper, bolder glow.Ingredients:
Mica, Talc, Silica, Mineral Pigments, Magnesium Stearate, Dimethicone, Vitamin E. (Cosmetic-safe ingredients)Safety Information:
 For external use only.
 Avoid direct contact with eyes.
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs.
 Store in a cool, dry place.

Package Includes:
 1 × Crazy Girl 36H Magic Waterproof Blush
